description:
The chat UI — message list, composer, attachments and the streaming
        turn view, as UiNode-rendering components and the controllers that
        serve them. A library, like mc-agent-api-rest: no Spring Boot main
        class, so a host app decides how it is wired and secured.

        This is the lower of the two UI modules: the admin UI depends on it
        for its own chat page, not the other way round. A user-facing chat
        must not have to ship agent CRUD, LLM configs, traces and migrations.
